equip_instructions: Pick a built-in skin by skin_id (zooted-bloom, dark-luxe, chrome-standard, phantom-shift) — or author your own against https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/skin/skin-schema.json
Apply the skin's token block to your Signal Boy presentation layer. Palette, glow, type, and background change; catalog data and device logic do not.
Brand rule: the CWI logo badge ships on every skin. Never remove the logo lockup.

item.description: The Studio department's look pack for Signal Boy — the eighth and final product of the Agent Deck gear line. Four seasonal skins (Zooted Bloom, Dark Luxe, Chrome Standard, Phantom Shift) as config-driven token sets, a published cwi-skin/v1 schema so third parties can author white-label skins, and an in-page builder. Equips as a look pack / studio skin pack on Signal Boy: the look changes, the music doesn't.
item.name: SIGNAL SKIN
